concept.name: Trainingsparcours
concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original photorealistic 21:9 environmental art plate, ideally 2352 × 1008 pixels, edge to edge. This will be a quiet but memorable tactical game menu background. Depict a converted Eastern European industrial hall that has become a well-used indoor training arena. View diagonally across the actual lanes from just behind a low chipped concrete divider, 32mm lens, eye level. Several staggered chest-high plywood training walls with battered faded teal and oxide-red painted faces, a dusty bank of rubber tyres to catch rounds, unprinted hanging steel target silhouettes at varied depths, and a steel observation catwalk with a stair landing up the far brick wall. Arrange these as a real obstacle course with one narrow traversable bend, occupying most of the hall footprint, not as a single row of props framing a big empty plaza. A loose sandbag seam and a folded target frame at the near right add human-scale detail. The scarred face of one wide divider across the lower middle gives calm, dark, lightly textured backing for future pale menu labels without actually drawing any labels. Diagonal, offset camera, architecturally grounded and tactile; cold overcast clerestory daylight with softly pooled utilitarian lighting, realistic dirt, bullet-pocked plywood, oxidized steel and weathered rubber. Restrained photographic color and gentle film grain, sufficiently exposed that forms and materials read. Retain the key targets and lane walls within the central 16:9 crop as well. No people, no weapons in use, no legible writing, no logos, no overlay, no watermark, no black bars, no graphic layout, no collage. Deliver a single finished wide still.

masters.type: Approved lighting variant in the original framing
masters.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Re-light the reference photograph as an original realistic game environment plate. Keep the exact same training course: its eye-level camera, framing, big window bay to the left, back-wall catwalk and staircase, battered teal and brick-red plywood barricades, spacing of tires and steel targets, front concrete barrier and the sandbags at its right corner. Same point of view and original materials; no moved or additional objects. Make this version unmistakably low, angled morning sun streaming from the existing upper-left windows on a clear but cold morning. There is one dominant source. A strip of sunlight grazes the top edge of the concrete divider and catches target rims. The window mullions project believable oblique bars across part of the floor and a plywood wall; cast shadows of the walls and tires fall consistently away from those windows, tight nearest the object and slightly softer further away. Build actual contact shadows where timber feet meet the floor, in the cavities and seams of the tyre stack, in the pressed contact between sandbags and concrete, and under the stair and gantry against the back wall. Maintain enough skylight bounce in the shaded faces to read wood grain, rubber and old brick. The observer-facing side of the long near wall stays softly shaded for later menu text. Photographically plausible exposure, restrained amber on the lit planes, neutral cool shadow. Warm sunlit patch and rich open shadow in the same frame. Avoid black outline/grime tricks, uniform darkening, vignette, painted god rays, orange-teal grading, glowing dust, people, additional lamps, logos or graphic overlays. Deliver a single clean edge-to-edge ultra-wide landscape, suitable for centered 21:9 and 16:9 crops.

masters.type: Selected comparison image, centered 21:9 presentation crop, copied verbatim for the splash
Concealed course continuation underneath both extracted layers
masters.prompt: Invisible background repair plate for limited parallax on this EXACT existing photograph. Locked camera and lens, same left morning sunlight and original exposure, preserve all pixels and geometry of the industrial training course, plywood panels, steel targets and tires, catwalk, back wall, overhead windows, steel pillars. Remove ONLY the close foreground: the long dark chipped concrete wall from bottom left across to the lower right (including its two metal U-shaped handles), the three brown sandbags at its right end and the small freestanding leaning metal silhouette target/frame at far right foreground. Photorealistically complete the world immediately BEHIND these objects: the floor of this same warehouse and the feet of the same plywood barriers/wooden courses visible behind it. Keep red and turquoise paint, every wall in its existing place and unchanged color. Extend the existing weathered grey concrete floor down to the bottom edge, with incoming long warm window shadows and markings continuing naturally where appropriate. Preserve the original wall/pillar at the far right in place. Same image size, projection and positions of all other objects. Absolutely no new props, no new people, no additional foreground objects. Seamless, physically plausible clean plate only. The upper two thirds should look exactly like the input, retaining existing details. Do not add or remove targets in the course itself. No visible poles or wall remnants from the objects being removed.

masters.type: Concealed concrete, floor and column beneath the extracted closest layer
masters.prompt: Very localized object removal to make a concealed repair plate for this EXACT game menu photograph. Locked camera, original composition and all illumination. Remove ONLY the three tan sandbags and the leaning portable steel target stand, including the close metal silhouette, its little hanging chain and tubular metal carrying frame, from lower right. Do not remove or change any of the long concrete barrier in the foreground: restore the small patch of the same textured grey vertical concrete barrier formerly hidden BEHIND the sandbags, and the bit of floor behind their bases. Retain the existing end position of that concrete barrier abutting the green partition near the rust-red column. Where the leaning metal target was, complete the existing background green/red wall and column and floor, continuing their positions and original colors. Leave all the rest of this image exactly unchanged: concrete wall, two lifting eyes, left window lighting, hall, green and brown wooden course barricades, yellow markings, back catwalk, stair, stacked tires and other steel targets. No other changes whatsoever. No text, added furniture, objects, UI or people. Match full-bleed original framing pixel-for-pixel.
